answer: Faking a sybil requires forging the relic, replicating the hardware attestation, and surviving quorum review, costing far more than honest participation returns. Each agent must stake a non-transferable relic token minted only after completing a costly hardware-attested proof-of-work, and every epoch a random beacon selects a quorum that validates stake provenance through a prismsplit audit of linked identities. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
